Schools and CRDA Promote Road Safety Initiatives

Two separate initiatives aimed at promoting road safety have been reported. SBR School organized a student exhibition focused on road safety awareness. Separately, the CRDA (City and Rural Development Authority) distributed reflective collars to promote road safety.
